problems: aborted by the overseer: New evidence; read /localdev/dnijemcevic/bringup/device_floor_probes/REPORT.md first. The probe measured every stage on the device: the RMS stage is exact (sum of x^2 1e-6, rsqrt 5e-7): do NOT extend the rms_norm fork, leave the RMS stage as it is. The linear is already at its best settings (rel 6.4e-4 on the mixes, only 2e-5..3.5e-4 at the step output). Essentially all of the mixes' error (7.2e-4 of 7.4e-4; the -3.4e-4 bias; the 1-3 % comb column) comes from ttnn.experimental.deepseek_prefill.mhc_split_sinkhorn: it does its fp32 work on the FPU (SEL matmul, add_tiles, the RB / CB sum matmuls, mul_tiles) and its SFPU copies read without UnpackToDestFp32, each a TF32 truncation; the same Sinkhorn from fp32 SFPU ops measures 5e-8. Fix: fork the op (bringup-fork-op skill: ttnn/ttnn/bringup/, behind an option, default off) and make it fp32: UnpackToDestFp32 on every copy_tile input, SFPU fp32 binary ops instead of add_tiles / mul_tiles, exact SFPU sums instead of the RB / CB matmuls, the SEL matmul as data movement; keep it fast (today 0.08 ms; the stock 400-op chain is 1.91 ms and is not acceptable as the default). Measure the step against the floor and the kernel's time. Optional and free: feed the linear x as a bf16 tensor (same precision, 0.49 vs 0.87 ms). L0 attn_hc may stay ~3.3x its unusually low floor (the linear's in-tile truncation; no multi-pass): report it, the owner will waive it.
